# ghost_storage_usage (Data Source)

Reads the storage a Ghost account uses against each of its quotas, in bytes: git data in its repositories, forks, Git LFS objects and release assets. Use it in a `check` block or a `precondition` to warn before a push or an upload would go over a quota.

Ghost shows storage usage only to the account itself, so `owner` must be the user that owns the provider's token or an organization that user belongs to. The figures are current: a push counts as soon as it lands, and a deleted repository or release asset stops counting at once. Deleted attachments stop counting a day later, and deleting a branch frees nothing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The storage the token's own user uses against its quotas.
data "ghost_storage_usage" "me" {}

# An organization the token's user belongs to.
data "ghost_storage_usage" "org" {
  owner = "my-org"
}

# Warn when the organization's repositories are close to their quota.
check "storage" {
  assert {
    condition = (
      data.ghost_storage_usage.org.quota_bytes == null ||
      data.ghost_storage_usage.org.used_bytes < 0.9 * data.ghost_storage_usage.org.quota_bytes
    )
    error_message = "my-org uses ${data.ghost_storage_usage.org.used_bytes} of its ${data.ghost_storage_usage.org.quota_bytes} bytes of repository storage."
  }
}

output "lfs_headroom_bytes" {
  value = data.ghost_storage_usage.me.lfs.quota_bytes - data.ghost_storage_usage.me.lfs.used_bytes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `owner` (String) The user or organization login, matched case-insensitively. Omit it to read the user that owns the provider's token.

### Read-Only

- `asset` (Attributes) Release assets in the account's repositories that are not forks and, for a user, files they attached to issues, pull requests and comments anywhere, uploads in progress included. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--asset))
- `fork` (Attributes) Everything the account's forks hold, Git LFS objects and release assets included, under one quota. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fork))
- `id` (String) The same as `owner`.
- `lfs` (Attributes) Git LFS objects in the account's repositories that are not forks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--lfs))
- `max_asset_bytes` (Number) The largest release asset Ghost accepts, in bytes.
- `quota_bytes` (Number) The quota for `used_bytes`, null when none applies.
- `used_bytes` (Number) Bytes of pushed git data and merged pull requests' heads in the account's repositories that are not forks. Git LFS objects, release assets and attachments are counted separately.

<a id="nestedatt--asset"></a>
### Nested Schema for `asset`

Read-Only:

- `quota_bytes` (Number) The quota in bytes, null when none applies.
- `used_bytes` (Number) Bytes counted against this quota.
